advice: The address is on the list you gave. Look at the process shown here: its command, the program that started it and the folder it ran in. Until you know why it reached that address, treat this Mac as affected; if nobody knows, ask your agent to look into it.
answers_note: Answer a finding only after the owner has agreed in this conversation, having been told what it is and what the options are. Pass --via agent and the reason the owner agreed to. The app shows every answer given this way.
kind: match of an indicator from the list
meaning: The list names files, sites and addresses that the attack is known to use, so a match is rarely chance; it is wrong only when the list itself is wrong.
